name: replace_card
description: Cancel the current card and issue a replacement.

client_id.description: Client identifier returned by find_client, or supplied by the orchestrator. Never invent one.

card_id.description: Card identifier returned by list_cards. Never invent one.

reason.description: Why it is being replaced. Ask the advisor; do not infer.

delivery_address.description: One of the addresses in the client profile (the system shows them as buttons). Never an address the advisor typed that is not in the profile.

flag_transactions.description: Only when the reason is lost or stolen: true if the client does not recognise recent transactions. The system asks with buttons.
